register_serialization_handler: register a new serialization handler class with DumpContext.register for a custom type
dump_value_to_info: dump a python value to a serialized info dict using DumpContext.dump
load_value_from_info: load a python value from a serialized info dict using DumpContext.load
cache_resource_with_factory: cache a resource like a memmap handle using DumpContext.cached with a factory callable
delete_serialized_files: delete files referenced by a serialized info dict using DumpContext.delete
